reason: A web GUI plugin-management panel for viewing plugin status, enabling or disabling installed plugins, and discovering or installing community plugins.

summaries.zh: 在 Web GUI 侧边栏提供插件管理面板，用于查看、启用或关闭已安装插件，并浏览和安装社区插件。
summaries.en: Adds a Web GUI plugin-management panel for viewing, enabling, disabling, discovering, and installing plugins.

capabilities: Adds a sidebar button and modal for managing installed plugins
Displays plugin loading and running states
Enables or disables installed plugins and applies the changes
Browses a community plugin catalog and installs selected plugins
Updates the web profile bundle configuration when plugins are installed or changed
